mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM ods_max_ad_stat_detail_ads omasda INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (omasda.gaid = dui.gaid and omasda.pkg = dui.pkg) WHERE omasda.dates = #{dates}

SELECT omasda.dates, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, omasda.ad_format, omasda.network, omasda.ad_exhibit, omasda.revenue, omasda.created create_time FROM ods_max_ad_stat_detail_ads omasda INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (omasda.gaid = dui.gaid and omasda.pkg = dui.pkg) WHERE omasda.dates = #{dates} limit #{startRows}, #{rows}
